subject: Hightide Checkout: incident summary, RCA draft, and closure commitments
messages:
From: Daniel Park <dpark@hightide.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, support@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena@hightide.io>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Severe latency and 500s affecting checkout — urgent

Team,

We started seeing large increases in latency and 500 errors on checkout around 08:45 PDT. Impact: ~18% of checkout requests failing (500s) and median latency spiking from ~220ms to ~2.1s for the next ~25 minutes. This disrupted the staging-to-production load test (and surfaced in our canary traffic). Our ops team has asked us to treat this as an urgent incident — they want an incident bridge and ETA for root cause analysis.

Can someone pick this up immediately? We need:
- A short bridge to walk through traces and mitigation steps
- A timeline of what happened and immediate mitigations (customer-visible)
- Ownership for a full RCA and commitments for remediation and SLAs

Thanks,
Daniel
VP, Engineering
Hightide Commerce
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@hightide.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Severe latency and 500s affecting checkout — urgent

Daniel — thanks for the heads up.

We just spun up an incident bridge (joining now). Immediate triage notes:
- We see a high rate of KV cache misses concurrent with a model-variant fallback that increased CPU usage on the inference path.
- Our autoscaling policy was constrained due to a recent capacity cap on the Dedicated pool for the region — this limited burst capacity.

Immediate actions Im initiating:
1) Enable temporary burst capacity in the Dedicated pool for Hightide (Ben)
2) Short-circuit the fallback quantized variant for checkout routes while we investigate (Jonas)
3) Start trace collection and attach perf bundle for your team (Karthik)

Well follow up on the bridge with an initial incident timeline and an owner for the RCA.

—Marissa
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 12:40:12 -0700
Subject: Internal: Bridge findings and immediate mitigations (perf bundle attached)

Team — post-bridge notes for the action tracker:

Summary of what we observed:
- 08:42: intermittent surge of small-batch requests causing KV cache churn (prefix miss rate jumped from 6% -> 42%).
- 08:43: inference runtime triggered fallback to quantized variant due to cache pressure; quantized path increased token decode CPU for that workload pattern.
- 08:45-09:05: autoscaler was at configured cap (customer Dedicated pool); cold starts and queueing added latency and produced 500s when queue timeout was reached.

Immediate mitigations executed:
- Enabled temporary burst capacity + increased pool cap by 30% (applied at 08:50) — observing drop in 500s after 08:53.
- Temporarily disabled quantized fallback on checkout-perf route (08:56) — reduced CPU variance.
- Captured and uploaded perf traces to the incident bucket (perf-traces-20261018.zip).

Open action items (owner / ETA):
- Ben: Confirm Dedicated pool scaling policy update is safe and add a short-term waiver for Hightide (ETA: 2026-10-19 11:00 PDT).
- Jonas: Produce RCA draft with timeline and root causes; include kernel selection and cache sizing analysis (ETA: 2026-10-19 08:00 PDT).
- Karthik: Share trace bundle and KV hotkey map, propose cache sizing change (ETA: 2026-10-19 09:30 PDT).

Attachments: [Attachment: perf-traces-20261018.zip (application/zip)]

Ben
Head of Runtime Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Martinez <elena@hightide.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 13:03:44 -0700
Subject: Re: Severe latency and 500s affecting checkout — urgent

Thanks — appreciate the quick response and mitigation. A couple asks from our side:
- We need a written RCA and the remediation plan by EOD Monday 10/19.
- Wed like a commitment on short-term capacity guarantees for the Black Friday validation window (11/20–11/28).
- Please include any rollback/traffic-split playbooks we can run if this pattern recurs during high-traffic windows.

Elena
Head of Platform Ops
Hightide Commerce
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@hightide.io>, Daniel Park <dpark@hightide.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Hightide incident RCA draft + action tracker (first delivery)

Elena / Daniel — attaching our RCA draft and the initial action tracker. Summary below; full doc attached.

RCA summary (high level):
- Primary root cause: KV cache churn due to an unexpected traffic fan-out pattern (checkout traffic with new experiment header) exposing a hotset larger than our configured cache window for the checkout route.
- Contributing causes: constrained Dedicated pool burst capacity (config cap prevented quick scale), and inference runtime fallback to quantized variant under cache pressure which increased CPU and affect queueing.

Customer-visible mitigations and commitments:
1) Short-term: temporary burst capacity enabled (complete) + rollback plan to pin model variant to full-precision for checkout route (attached rollback-plan-20261019.md).
2) Mid-term (2–3 weeks): adjust cache sizing and introduce adaptive KV prefetching for hot prefixes (owner: Karthik, ETA: 2026-11-05).
3) Long-term (30–60 days): model-variant policy change and autoscaler tuning, plus a runbook for Black Friday window (owner: Ben, ETA: 2026-11-20).

Ownership and SLAs:
- We will provide a Dedicated pool burst guarantee for the Black Friday validation window and a written SLA addendum by 10/22 (owner: Kimberly).
- Weekly progress updates beginning 10/27 until final closure.

Attachments: [Attachment: hightide-rca-draft.pdf (application/pdf)]

Weve scheduled a short exec readout for Tue 10/20 10:30 PDT to review the RCA and commitments. Please confirm availability.

—Marissa
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

- We provided the rollback playbook and an operational runbook that your SREs can execute; were adding a traffic-split quick rollback to the top of the runbook.
- Short-term SLA addendum delivery ETA: 2026-10-22 COB (DocuSign link below).
